title: Coking Coal Supply Secure for India's Steel Industry: Jindal
dek: Coking coal supply for India's steel industry is secure, according to remarks attributed to Jindal in a Rediff MoneyWiz headline.
summary: Rediff MoneyWiz reports that a Jindal executive has said coking coal supply for India's steel industry is secure. Only a headline is available. It does not identify the speaker or the company, nor give any sourcing or volume details.
keyFacts: Coking coal supply described as secure for India's steel industry
whyItMatters: India relies heavily on imported coking coal for blast furnace steelmaking, so assurances on supply security bear on cost and production planning.
implications: If the assessment holds, mills may face less near-term supply risk. The excerpt gives no information on prices.
